nodes.label: Building a Custom CMS - From Figma to CodeIgniter with Materialize
nodes.author: Gervis Bermudez
nodes.norm_label: building a custom cms - from figma to codeigniter with materialize
nodes.rationale: Chose PHP CodeIgniter for simplicity, speed, MVC separation, and community support; Blade for reusable views; Materialize.css for a Material Design UI; MySQL/MariaDB for relational integrity; REST API modules so the frontend can manage users, pages, forms, and media.

nodes.norm_label: solving the hotel reservation problem using vue js with vite
nodes.rationale: Vue.js plus Vite with Pinia stores; cheapest-hotel algorithm sums weekday/weekend rates by customer type and breaks ties by rating. No CSS framework because the test forbade them.

nodes.label: From API to UI: Building a SpaceX Launch Tracker with NextJs and Tailwind
nodes.author: Gervis Bermudez
nodes.norm_label: from api to ui: building a spacex launch tracker with nextjs and tailwind
nodes.rationale: Next.js App Router and TypeScript for the tech test; Tailwind theme tokens from Figma; React context for launches, pagination, and favorites persisted in localStorage; fetchLaunches merges SpaceX rockets and launches APIs.

nodes.label: Shared Chrome
nodes.rationale: A change to default layout plus side, menu, top-banner, footer, or contact-banner hits every page, so visual diffs must stay minimal.

nodes.label: Contact Banner Layout Ownership
nodes.rationale: Do not include contact-banner.html in the post body because _layouts/post.html already includes it. Posts set contact_banner in front matter only.

nodes.label: CSS-First Override
nodes.rationale: Prefer a CSS override in public/css/styles.css and keep art-* and elementor-* class names. Touch _includes or _layouts only when CSS cannot do it; do not restyle Arter into a new design system or edit vendor theme/plugin trees unless a one-off bug is justified.

nodes.label: Six-Surface UI Verification
nodes.rationale: After shared layout/CSS/include changes, check Home, About, Blog, one post, Portfolio, and Contact at 1440 and 390 so sidebar, menu, and footer stay consistent.

nodes.label: No Hardcoded /site Prefix
nodes.rationale: Do not hardcode /site to fix github.io 404s. That breaks local serve (empty baseurl) and can double-prefix in production. Prefer Liquid relative_url or absolute_url so Jekyll writes /site/ into _site.

nodes.label: Graphify Query First
nodes.rationale: If graphify-out/graph.json exists, answer architecture questions with graphify query. Do not rebuild unless --update or the user asks.
